F01.issue: ProcessDecision duplication/circularity and mixed stage-state axes
F01.resolution: Pure existing policy projection; separate obligation, outcome and freshness; no new aggregate or cursor.

F02.issue: Verification invalidates itself on service-only Task revision
F02.resolution: Reuse existing verification-input family; separate exact admission from material check identity and current obligation coverage.

F03.issue: Independent evaluator disabled before actual quality qualification
F03.resolution: No default activation before independent Q01 and economic Q02; code path alone is insufficient.

F04.issue: Migration CAS races with dispatch/result/provider effects
F04.resolution: Preview before cutover; common admission fence covers managed, external, native validation and integration.

F05.issue: Unknown exclusion can be treated as safe applicability
F05.resolution: All required true AND all excluded false; unknown blocks deterministic instantiation.

F06.issue: Closure is post-hoc, incomplete or invalidated by unrelated catalogue changes
F06.resolution: Pre-execution transitive closure; retain bytes; repin specialization before approval; separate catalogue update, tamper and revocation.

F07.resolution: Return to ordinary obligation resolution; no selector-only episode.

F08.issue: Incomplete telemetry and proxy benchmarks treated as release proof
F08.resolution: Durable provider-bound all-attempt usage; A/B/C production driver; explicit separate safety/activation/claim gates.

F09.issue: Too much functionality and unnecessary critical-path coupling
F09.resolution: Six release barriers; architecture, owner convergence, post-convergence test cleanup, planning, recipes and evaluation activation are distinct.

N01.issue: Roadmap proposes another inline input schema despite existing compact Plan input
N01.resolution: Reuse task-centric compact proposal input V2 and its normalizer; no second InlineTaskContract.

N02.issue: Generic VerificationBinding V2 duplicates current task_verification_input v4
N02.resolution: Version the existing family only when necessary; no parallel evidence identity.

N03.issue: Newer kernel chosen as canonical without hosted/context/recovery parity
N03.resolution: Keep Task Kernel as the canonical reducer; extract the coordinator from the mature ordinary route/effect path, map every guarantee, then retire duplicate executors.

N04.issue: Blueprint removal implicitly depends on future Recipe V2
N04.resolution: Use bounded V1 guidance/validator conversions in .10; formal procedural V2 conversion is .13.

N05.issue: External outstanding WorkOrders are invisible to PID-only quiescence
N05.resolution: Include pending external work in fencing and migration blockers, even without a managed process.

N06.issue: State-fingerprint components still refer to removed Blueprint
N06.resolution: Explicit versioned fingerprint/WorkOrder transition preserves all material constraints.

N07.issue: Local receipt digests cannot reconstruct evidence after fresh clone/pruning
N07.resolution: Portable retained-byte/reachable-object contract; missing payload is not regenerated or guessed.

N08.issue: Provider-only accounting hides host Plan construction cost
N08.resolution: Whole intent-to-result accounting including host work; unallocatable shared turns are explicit.

N09.issue: Every atomic checklist item becomes another heavyweight task lifecycle
N09.resolution: Atomic diff/acceptance unit is not a requirement for one PR or paid episode; use scoped WorkItems and existing evidence.

N10.issue: Backend serialization, platform or adapter differences weaken guarantees during cutover
N10.resolution: Supported-port round trips, capability preflight, platform path tests and exact format errors; no silent fallback.

N11.issue: Completed prior fixes are repeated as new feature work
N11.resolution: Current source lock and already_satisfied verification; preserve NGDG6V/P1MJV7 improvements and reuse existing parsers.

N12.issue: Current rules or generated views reopen terminal work and produce churn
N12.resolution: Terminal replay is a canonical/effect no-op; historical policy audit does not silently schedule new work.

N13.issue: Live quality study scheduled before the candidate path exists, or public callers retired after their imported engine
N13.resolution: Move cold decoders and public callers first; test an inactive implementation before independent study, then activate only after qualification.

N14.issue: New fencing is incorrectly assumed to restrain an already-running pre-fence binary
N14.resolution: Require demonstrated old-worker quiescence/reconciliation; refuse unknown status. Do not claim a new epoch retroactively controls a nonparticipating process.

N15.issue: A global active JEV switch silently activates unqualified semantic decisions
N15.resolution: Expand presets into purpose policy; bind every active purpose to exact Q03 evidence and fail closed independently.

N16.issue: Evaluator pass or small zero-error samples are treated as proof that review added no value
N16.resolution: Use material-value and ambiguous labels, adversarial strata and a preregistered one-sided false-skip bound before activation.
